subjects: three bounded utility roles: clean, export, verify
composition: show a small number of cards
keep the person and assistant unobstructed
use a quiet copy panel for orientation text
make local-first boundaries feel calm rather than alarmist
text_policy: Narrative raster assets carry one exact short title plus one exact short subtitle; SVGs and tiny helper graphics stay text-free.
reject_when: the visual implies a universal scraper
permission or warning graphics overwhelm the subject
the title or subtitle is unreadable
the cards become a dense dashboard
the asset looks like an alternate hero instead of explaining a boundary
